title: readability: test files import UserCredential from reader config, not stoa_auth
description: e2e_data_flow.rs and injection_provenance_e2e.rs import stoa_reader::config::UserCredential. That works because of the pub-use re-export, but it obscures that UserCredential lives in stoa_auth. A reader in 12 months will search for the struct definition in config.rs and find only a re-export, adding an indirection step. The two integration-test files already import directly from stoa_auth and never need UserCredential — so the inconsistency is within the reader crate's own tests. Suggested fix: change the two reader test files to use stoa_auth::UserCredential to match the pattern in the integration tests and make the type's home obvious at the use site.
